<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Disponíveis

Os limites vêm de observações da comunidade. Contribuições privadas podem contar com a configuração ativada.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Criar um repositório com **16 estrelas**; os níveis superiores dependem das estrelas desse repositório.

**Níveis:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (estrelas do repositório).

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Ser autor de **2 pull requests mesclados**.

**Níveis:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (PRs mesclados do autor).

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Ser coautor de commits em **1 PR mesclado**, com atribuição `Co-authored-by` correta.

**Níveis:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (PRs mesclados com coautoria).

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Obter **2 respostas aceitas** em Discussions. Em `github.com/orgs/community` desativado desde 2024-02-06.

**Níveis:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (respostas aceitas).

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

Fechar uma issue ou PR **em até 5 minutos** após a abertura.

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>
### YOLO

<img src="../assets/badges/yolo-default.png" width="96" alt="YOLO">

Mesclar seu próprio PR **sem revisão de código**; regras oficiais detalhadas não foram publicadas.

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ Históricas

Esses eventos terminaram. Prêmios existentes podem permanecer; novas contribuições não os desbloqueiam.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

Contribuir para um repositório elegível no **snapshot Arctic Code Vault de 2020-02-02**. Evento encerrado.

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

Criar um commit numa versão específica usada pelo **NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. Evento encerrado.

[Exemplo real](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

| [Galaxy Brain](#galaxy-brain) | respostas aceitas | 2 | 8 | 16 | 32 |

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Destaques de perfil

Highlights são destaques separados de programas e contas; a disponibilidade depende do programa.

| Nome | Estado | Condição | Fontes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Disponíveis | Usar GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Disponíveis | Participar do Developer Program e criar uma aplicação com a API do GitHub. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Disponíveis | Informar uma vulnerabilidade elegível do GitHub pelo Bug Bounty. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Disponíveis | Participar do GitHub Campus Experts; conferir as regras atuais de candidatura. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Disponíveis | Receber crédito em um aviso de segurança aceito no GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Disponíveis | Ser selecionado para GitHub Stars; estrelas do repositório não bastam. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Históricas | Destaque histórico de respostas aceitas; substituição por Galaxy Brain relatada em 2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |
